package.description: A desktop app for managing ChatGPT and Codex accounts locally.

en-US.description: A desktop app for managing ChatGPT and Codex accounts locally.
en-US.longDescription: StarBox is a locally run desktop application for managing ChatGPT and Codex accounts on Windows. Use it to manage multiple accounts, view quotas and available models, track requests and token usage, call models through a local gateway, and create images. Account credentials, usage records, and generated content are stored locally on your device.
en-US.name: StarBox

zh-CN.description: 一款本地运行的 ChatGPT/Codex 账号管理桌面应用。
zh-CN.longDescription: StarBox 是一款本地运行的 ChatGPT/Codex 账号管理桌面应用，支持 Windows。你可以使用 StarBox 管理多个账号、查看额度和可用模型、统计请求与 Token 消耗，并通过本地网关调用模型或进行图片创作。账号凭证、使用记录和创作内容均保存在本机。
